skills.name: agent-docs-hub
skills.purpose: Publishes and updates every agent's user guide and release notes on this hub, screenshots included.

skills.name: agentic-harness-designer
skills.purpose: Designs and reviews AI agent systems as a whole: the tools, permissions, safety rails and workflows around the model, not just the model choice.

skills.name: assumption-checker
skills.purpose: Reads a plan or strategy document and lists the hidden assumptions, missing evidence and contradictions before you act on it.

skills.name: audience-content-system
skills.purpose: Writes content calibrated to one specific publication and audience level, for example a beginner-focused newsletter.

skills.name: automation-discovery
skills.purpose: Digs through real work history (AI sessions, Slack, tickets) to find and prove which recurring jobs are worth automating, then builds the chosen one.

skills.name: brain-dump-processor
skills.purpose: Turns a messy voice memo or rambling note into cleanly separated ideas, evaluates which are worth pursuing, and files them.

skills.name: branded-image-prompting
skills.purpose: A prompting guide that keeps every generated image on brand: colors, typography, composition and recurring formats.

skills.name: broll-pipeline
skills.purpose: Turns a finished talking-head video into one with animated motion graphics inserted at exactly the right moments.

skills.name: browser-qa
skills.purpose: Tests web pages like a professional: performance, errors, responsive and accessibility checks, click-through flows, with screenshots as evidence.

skills.name: buzz-comms
skills.purpose: Posts to and reads from Buzz, the private team chat where humans and agents coordinate.

skills.name: case-data-normalization
skills.purpose: Turns messy case facts into one clean ledger of dates, parties, amounts, categories and review status.

skills.name: chief-of-staff
skills.purpose: Runs the daily operating rhythm: morning briefing, coordination across tasks and follow-ups, end-of-day review.

skills.name: citation-guard
skills.purpose: Checks that every claim in a draft actually matches the evidence it cites: the source must exist and say what is claimed.

skills.name: clean-my-ai-harness
skills.purpose: Maps everything the agent is configured with and proposes a safe cleanup of stale instructions, memories and skills.

skills.name: content-radar
skills.purpose: Watches followed influencers daily and delivers a rated morning digest to Telegram, with one-tap booking of reading slots.

skills.name: cron-audit
skills.purpose: The weekly report of every scheduled job: what runs, what has gone silent, what is switched off.

skills.name: current-info-search
skills.purpose: Sends web research through a search API built for fresh information instead of the harness's built-in search.

skills.name: deep-research
skills.purpose: Deep, multi-source, fact-checked research: the question is broken down, primary sources read, and every claim adversarially verified.

skills.name: deterministic-retrieval-map
skills.purpose: Lookup tables that say exactly which document sections matter for each case type, so retrieval stops guessing.

skills.name: document-chunking-tagging
skills.purpose: Splits ingested documents into addressable, tagged sections so agents can cite the exact place a fact came from.

skills.name: end-feature
skills.purpose: The ship-time closeout of a feature: tests verified on the real build, screenshots taken, docs published to the hub, announcement material generated, Ship Card written.

skills.name: essay-illustration-gallery
skills.purpose: Illustrates a finished essay end to end: picks the image-worthy moments, generates consistent images, and builds the gallery page.

skills.name: feature-blueprint
skills.purpose: The pre-development gate: press release, user tests, release-note draft, guide updates and marketing pack, all before one line of code.

skills.name: frontend-taste
skills.purpose: Stronger design instincts for anything web-built: varied layouts, real typography, restrained color, and screenshot-verified results.

skills.name: goal-prompt-generator
skills.purpose: Turns a fuzzy plan into a bounded objective for an agent, with a definition of done, hard limits and stop conditions.

skills.name: heavy-file-ingestion
skills.purpose: Converts big, agent-hostile files (large PDFs, decks, spreadsheets) into light readable artifacts before any analysis begins.

skills.name: html-artifacts
skills.purpose: Turns dense output (plans, research, reviews, comparisons) into one polished, self-contained HTML page.

skills.name: human-gate
skills.purpose: The stop line for high-stakes work: agents prepare, draft and validate; a human reviews, signs, sends, files or pays.

skills.name: image-gateway
skills.purpose: Generates or edits images through one API with a single command and no per-call setup.

skills.name: image-model-arena
skills.purpose: Builds side-by-side comparison pages for image-generation models running the same prompts.

skills.name: kara-release-notes
skills.purpose: Kara's ship ritual: write the notes entry, release to the self-update feed, publish the updates pages.

skills.name: link-digest
skills.purpose: Summarizes and rates any link Thomas shares in Telegram, and books an evening reading slot when it is worth the time.

skills.name: media-transcription
skills.purpose: Transcribes audio and video files into clean transcripts with timestamps, chapters and speaker labels.

skills.name: meeting-synthesis
skills.purpose: Turns a meeting recording or transcript into takeaways, decisions with owners, action items and open questions.

skills.name: meetingbrief
skills.purpose: Prepares a meeting: pulls the calendar event, researches the external attendees, and delivers the brief to Telegram.

skills.name: my-voice
skills.purpose: Encodes how Thomas actually writes, per context, so drafts sound like him instead of like an AI.

skills.name: nle-assistant
skills.purpose: Drives the video editor (DaVinci Resolve) directly: silence removal, subclips and timelines built inside the real project.

skills.name: open-agent-engine
skills.purpose: The runner playbook for the Linear task queue: claim exactly one task, do the scoped work, leave receipts.

skills.name: open-brain-case-store
skills.purpose: Keeps the normalized case-file records inside Open Brain instead of a local database.

skills.name: openbrain
skills.purpose: Search, capture and log to Open Brain, the durable knowledge base of decisions, meetings, people and context.

skills.name: packet-export
skills.purpose: Packages reviewed outputs into an editable folder and PDF: draft, citation map, checklist and source manifest.

skills.name: page-testing-memory
skills.purpose: Keeps page-specific testing facts (selectors, test accounts, cleanup quirks) in repo-local runbooks where they belong.

skills.name: para-ai-filing-context
skills.purpose: Teaches agents the PARA filing logic before they save, export or publish any deliverable, so nothing gets misfiled.

skills.name: para-filing-auditor
skills.purpose: Audits and reorganizes the PARA filing systems on Dropbox and Google Drive, always plan-first with explicit approval.

skills.name: para-organizer
skills.purpose: Sets up or cleans a PARA folder structure (Projects, Areas, Resources, Archives) on the local file system.

skills.name: pdf-document-ingestion
skills.purpose: Converts PDFs, scans and forms into markdown or tables with stable references back to the exact source spot.

skills.name: project-intake-router
skills.purpose: Sets up a new project properly before work starts: PARA home, folder structure, brief, milestones, skills and human gates.

skills.name: radio-edit
skills.purpose: Locks the spoken narrative of a video first, as a transcript-driven rough cut, before any visuals are touched.

skills.name: reading-pack-builder
skills.purpose: Builds a controlled local reading page from a pile of documents so review happens in one place.

skills.name: release-briefing
skills.purpose: Turns gathered data about a significant release in the field into a clear, decision-ready briefing.

skills.name: ringer
skills.purpose: The verified-swarm playbook: batches of work routed to cheap workers, with executable checks deciding pass or fail.

skills.name: self-pr-merge
skills.purpose: Reviews and merges Thomas's own pull requests with real discipline despite GitHub's self-approval limits.

skills.name: session-operating-map
skills.purpose: A per-project map of parallel agent sessions so lanes of work stay named and never collide.

skills.name: session-to-skill-extractor
skills.purpose: Reviews a finished work session for reusable patterns and drafts them as new or updated skills.

skills.name: site-publisher
skills.purpose: Publishes a finished page to the personal or company website as a real, share-ready URL.

skills.name: skill-promoter
skills.purpose: The weekly sweep that finds skills created locally on any agent surface and promotes new ones into the shared GitHub catalog, so every skill reaches all agents and this reference page.

skills.name: skills-status
skills.purpose: Shows every catalog skill with a check of whether it is installed in the agent you are talking to.

skills.name: sqlite-case-store
skills.purpose: A local SQLite database for source documents, chunks, normalized records and validation results.

skills.name: stakeholder-update-email
skills.purpose: After work ships, sends or drafts a short, truthful update email to the person who needs to know.

skills.name: start-here
skills.purpose: The front-door reflex for every task: recap open loops, run the routing test out loud, pick the lightest tool that still leaves an inspectable result.

skills.name: testing-runbook-creator
skills.purpose: Ensures testing discoveries get written into runbooks instead of dying in the chat where they were found.

skills.name: visible-delegation
skills.purpose: Lets one agent drive another in a shared terminal session so delegated work stays visible.

skills.name: weekly-signal-diff
skills.purpose: Reviews a defined set of inputs on a cadence and reports only what changed since last time.
